# 🎉 PartMart Boost v0.3.5e - Liquid Glass UI Released!

**Release Date:** January 29, 2026  
**Version:** 0.3.5e (Package 3.9a)  
**Stage:** 7.8a - Liquid Glass UI Revolution  

---

## 🌟 MAJOR UPDATE - Beautiful UI!

PartMart Boost получил **полное визуальное обновление** с потрясающим Liquid Glass интерфейсом!

### ✨ Highlights

🎨 **Liquid Glass Design System**
- Apple-inspired glassmorphism
- Frosted blur effects
- Translucent panels

🎮 **Steam-Style Game Cards**
- Beautiful 300x200px tiles
- Soft rounded corners (16px)
- Hover glow effects (MSI red)
- Real-time metrics (CPU/RAM)

🔴 **MSI Color Palette**
- Signature red (#E30613)
- Deep blacks (#0A0A0A)
- Sharp grays
- Gaming aesthetic

💨 **Smooth Animations**
- Fade in/out
- Slide transitions
- Scale effects
- 60fps smooth

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Install
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Launch
python launcher.py

# Select: 1 (Modern GUI)
```

## 📦 What's New

### Design System
- ✅ Liquid Glass theme
- ✅ MSI color palette
- ✅ Border radius system
- ✅ Animation timings

### Custom Widgets
- ✅ GameCard (soft tiles)
- ✅ GlassPanel (frosted)
- ✅ ModernButton (animated)

### Animations
- ✅ Fade in/out
- ✅ Slide transitions
- ✅ Scale effects

### Main Window
- ✅ Modern layout
- ✅ Status dashboard
- ✅ Game library grid
- ✅ Performance metrics
